html:
Tokentrim Free Dashboard

The Tokentrim free dashboard shows you Claude Code token usage on your machine. Install the toolkit, open the dashboard, and you can view history, limits, and cost‑saving metrics.

How it works

  1. Clone the repo or install the plugin.
  2. Run the dashboard command; it loads your local token data.
  3. The dashboard displays your current token budget, the number of steps used, and a replay of your last 28,854 steps.
  4. You can set a daily budget guard and receive a cold‑cache alert directly from the interface.

What you get

  • All hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold‑cache alert are free.
  • No data leaves your machine unless you choose to share it.
  • Requires Python 3.9+ and works on macOS and Linux.
  • The free version is limited to the local machine. Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80%, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.

FAQ

How much can I save with the free dashboard? In 135 real conversations, trimming history re‑reads cut by 75% and extended limits by 4.0×, lowering billed cost by roughly 55‑70%. Shrinking tool output alone saved 6.9%.

Can I use it with multiple machines? The free version is limited to one machine. The Pro plan supports up to 3 machines.

Is there a team dashboard? A shared team dashboard is in development; a paid team audit is available on request.

Start using the Tokentrim free dashboard
